title: Blade Basics: Echo, Escaping aur Data
objectives: Blade kya hai aur `.blade.php` files kaise kaam karti hain samajhna
`{{ }}` se data dikhana aur automatic escaping jaanna
`{!! !!}` kab aur kyun khatarnak hai samajhna
View ko data bhejne ke teen tareeke jaanna
JavaScript frameworks ke saath `@` aur `@verbatim` use karna

sections.heading: Blade kya hai?
sections.body: Blade Laravel ka built-in template engine hai. Blade tumhe plain PHP likhne se rokta nahi, aur sab Blade templates compile hokar plain PHP ban jaate hain aur cache ho jaate hain, isliye extra overhead lagbhag zero hota hai. Blade files `.blade.php` extension ke saath `resources/views` mein hoti hain.

callout.text: Blade = HTML + chhote shortcuts (`{{ }}`, `@if`, `@foreach`). Saari logic nahi, sirf dikhane ka kaam yahan karo.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Product page
sections.body: Customer ko page par product ka naam aur price dikhana hai. Controller data bhejta hai, Blade use HTML mein daal deta hai.

code.code:
<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

Route::get('/greeting', function () {
    return view('greeting', [
        'name' => 'Asha',
        'comment' => '<script>alert("hi")</script>',
    ]);
});

explain: `{{ $name }}` – variable ki value print karta hai.
`{{ ... }}` ke andar koi bhi PHP expression likh sakte ho.
`{{ $city ?? 'Delhi' }}` – variable na ho to default value.

sections.heading: Escaping: XSS se bachav
sections.body:
Blade ke `{{ }}` statements apne aap PHP ke `htmlspecialchars` se guzarte hain, jisse XSS attack se bachav hota hai. Upar wale example mein `<script>` tag text ban kar dikhega, chalega nahi.

`{!! !!}` escaping band kar deta hai. Isse sirf tab use karo jab data poori tarah tumhara apna aur trusted ho.

callout.text: User se aaya data (comment, name, bio) hamesha `{{ }}` se dikhao. `{!! !!}` mein user ka data daloge to XSS vulnerability banegi.

sections.heading: View ko data bhejne ke tareeke
explain: Teeno ka natija same hai. Array wala tareeka sabse saaf hai.

sections.heading: Comments, @php aur JavaScript ke saath
sections.body: Blade comment HTML output mein nahi aata. Agar JavaScript framework (Vue, Alpine) ki `{{ }}` ko Blade se bachana hai, to `@` lagao ya `@verbatim` use karo. PHP array ko JavaScript mein dene ke liye `Js::from` use karo.
explain: `@{{ name }}` – `@` hat jaata hai aur `{{ name }}` waise hi browser ko jaata hai.
`Js::from($data)` – array/object ko safe JavaScript value bana deta hai.

versionDiff.heading: Blade: Laravel 11, 12 aur 13
versionDiff.intro: Blade ka core syntax teeno versions mein same hai.

items.13: Same core. Latest docs mein kuch naye helper directives (jaise `@context`) bhi dikhte hain. Zarurat par official Blade docs dekho.

errors.cause: View ko `products` data pass hi nahi hua, ya naam alag hai.
errors.fix: `view('x', compact('products'))` ya array mein sahi key do.

errors.cause: View ka naam file path se match nahi karta.

errors.error: Page par `<script>` ya HTML text ban kar dikh raha hai
errors.cause: `{{ }}` escape karta hai (yeh sahi behaviour hai).
errors.fix: Agar HTML dikhana hi hai aur data trusted hai to `{!! !!}`, warna data ko HTML mein mat daalo.

debug.body: View mein variable ki value dekhne ke liye `@dump($var)` ya `{{ dd($var) }}` use karo. Purani compiled view cache clear karne ke liye `view:clear`.

code.code:
php artisan view:clear
php artisan view:cache

tasks: `/profile` route banao jo `name`, `city`, `bio` data view ko bheje
`profile.blade.php` mein teeno dikhao, city ke liye default value do
`bio` mein `bold` daal kar `{{ }}` aur `{!! !!}` ka farak dekho
Ek `@php` block se do numbers ka total nikal kar dikhao

quiz.why: `{{ }}` data ko `htmlspecialchars` se escape karke dikhata hai.

quiz.q: User ka comment dikhane ke liye kaunsa syntax sahi hai?
quiz.why: User data ke liye hamesha escaped `{{ }}`.

interview.a: Laravel ka template engine. `.blade.php` templates plain PHP mein compile hokar cache hote hain.
`{{ }}` output ko escape karta hai (XSS se bachav). `{!! !!}` raw output deta hai, isliye sirf trusted data ke liye.

interview.q: View ko data kaise bhejte hain?
Vue/Alpine ke saath Blade ke `{{ }}` ka conflict kaise solve karte hain?
Blade ko plain PHP kyun kehte hain?
interview.a: Kyunki Blade templates compile hokar plain PHP files banti hain aur tum template mein seedha PHP bhi likh sakte ho.

summary: View ko data array, `with()` ya `compact()` se do.
Logic kam rakho, sirf dikhane ka kaam Blade mein.
